newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt pound overnight steady in tight market.
newsitem.headline: Egypt pound overnight steady in tight market.

text.p: Overnight interbank rates on the Egyptian pound remained firm on Wednesday in a tight market.
Bankers quoted rates between 10-1/8 and 10-5/16 percent from Tuesday's range of 10 to 10-1/2 percent. A few even said they made deals at rates as high as 11 percent.
Public sector banks, the lenders of last resort, offer minimum lending rates of 10-1/2 percent.
Some bankers said they did not make any one-week deals because of the shortage in the market while others quoted rates of around 10-7/16 percent from between 10-1/4 and 10-7/16 percent on Tuesday.
